body:
GADGET / PM — MSE-ALL-ZIP-DATA-20261121-07 revision1

Exact user request: “assign workers to expand the importer to all the data in the zip, not just bp. we need it all available in the database for mother and coach. keep the actual import manual and give me the updated script when its ready.”

Scope correction: BP-only normalization is not acceptance. Preserve prior successful parent-BP catalog and all originals. Expand the protected archive/database path so every ZIP member and source occurrence is accounted for and retrievable. Provide universal lossless structured representation of XML attributes, text, ordered children and metadata with stable artifact/member/occurrence lineage, plus protected content-addressed payload storage for attachments and other files. Typed family adapters cover supported quantities, categories, sleep, workouts/activity, characteristics, correlations, series/routes, ECG, clinical/medication and other observed families. Unknown or unsupported shapes remain queryable through bounded structured fallback, rather than merely counted or silently dropped. Preserve exact originals and explicit quarantine content/reasons.

Acceptance: source member/occurrence accounting reconciles typed, fallback and quarantine without double-counting nested occurrences. Every retained member has content retrieval; every source record has a queryable protected representation. Preserve units, exposed source clocks, ordering and explicit relationship provenance; no pairing/dedup by timestamps alone. Verify deterministic exact replay, receipt-gated transactional acceptance, interrupted and cutoff recovery, actual protected VM reopen and bounded Mother/Coach query examples across families and attachments. A family label, inventory total or opaque ZIP alone is not database availability. Distinguish full-fidelity storage from typed support and consumer readiness.

Database availability does not mean automatically sending every sensitive field to model prompts. Provide documented protected roles and purpose-scoped query interfaces; keep identity mappings, private keys, unrestricted source metadata and default consumer views separate. Exact physiology and dates remain sensitive. Existing authorization permits implementing and qualifying private infrastructure and synthetic tests. Actual real-archive processing/import stays MANUAL and user-owned. Do not mount, unpack, reparse, replay or transfer real import data automatically. Prepare one updated exact-pinned manual artifact after source, completeness and environment verification, with sanitized status and fresh finite admission. No additional user approval for already-authorized scope; actual missing facts remain explicit.

Owners: ATLAS freezes universal coverage/schema/query contract; FORGE implements full-fidelity store, family adapters and bounded Mac-to-VM ingestion; ORACLE defines Mother/Coach query acceptance; PHOENIX qualifies protected persistent database/blob storage and finite transport; NICKY owns manual script and safe operator readback; SENTINEL reviews changed parser/storage/access boundaries; PROVENANCE independently verifies completeness and reproducibility; LONESTAR maintains the single stage board. All eight initial dispatches accepted; acknowledgment and execution remain separate.

Preserve active8446, originals, existing successful catalog and private key custody. No main merge, real Nightscout access, uncontrolled model forwarding or unrelated host changes. Backups/restores remain deferred. Health Portal findings and reciprocal Mother links remain required closeout after validation. Next user deliverable is a verified full-data manual script, not another BP-only run.
